name: r1distill_llama8b_longcot
description: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B (identical arch to Llama-3.1-8B): the long-CoT reasoning axis. The Llama grid's reasoning cells are method-insensitive (near-chance model); R1-distill thinks for thousands of decode tokens, making reasoning cells discriminative for streaming quantization for the first time. Calibration = unified 198-prompt GPQA corpus (rotations_gpqa198 recipe + gpqacc64k codebook recipe). Sampling per DeepSeek card: T=0.6, top-p 0.95, no top-k; 32K generation caps for reasoning.

calibration.rotation_recipe: capture_qkv_dump 198 prompts (R1 chat template) -> compute_kv_rotation qqt_sst r_h_pbr head-dim 128
calibration.k_codebook_recipe: capture_mixed_concat gpqa-only 8x65536 -> train_group_vq_alloc stratified/flat/bpc2/ptn -> fp8 e5m2; built by build_r1distill.sh

protocol.niah: greedy (T=0), 1 rollout/row, gen cap 128, mean RULER string_match over 8 subtasks
protocol.reasoning: thinking mode (template auto-opens <think>), gen cap 32768, AIME25 avg@4 (30 rows), math500 subset avg@2 (fraction 0.2 = 100 rows, seed 42) — scoped for overnight; full-K expansion is a follow-up
protocol.shortval_gate: before full cells: 20-row math sample must show </think> closure, extraction working, cap-hit <= 15% at 32K
